description: MOCK. transfer_code_recheck with a transfer bundled with another call: the whole message is held, NEITHER call executes, both are reported to the agent as not executed, and the agent then recovers: it repeats the search (executed) and transfers with the graded code (executed).

args.summary: Customer reports someone else claims ownership of their account.

user.say: Hi, someone else says my checking account is theirs and I need a human to sort it out.
